    """Tests for EmbeddingStrategyRegistry.embed_all."""

    async def test_embed_all_all_succeed(self, registry, signal, dim):
        """embed_all with all strategies succeeding returns all embeddings."""
        registry.register("alpha", DeterministicStrategy(dim=dim, seed=1))
        registry.register("beta", DeterministicStrategy(dim=dim, seed=2))

        result = await registry.embed_all(signal)

        registry.register("fail_a", FailingStrategy())
        registry.register("fail_b", FailingStrategy())

        result = await registry.embed_all(signal)
        assert len(result.embeddings) == 0
        assert len(result.failures) == 2

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_embed_all_mixed(self, registry, signal, dim):
        """embed_all with mixed success/failure categorizes correctly."""
        registry.register("good", DeterministicStrategy(dim=dim, seed=1))
        registry.register("bad", FailingStrategy())

        result = await registry.embed_all(signal)
        total = len(result.embeddings) + len(result.failures)
        assert total == 2, "Successes + failures should equal total strategies"
        assert len(result.embeddings) == 1
        assert len(result.failures) == 1
        assert "good" in result.embeddings

        for name, vec in result.embeddings.items():

        """embed_all does not raise when individual strategies fail — invariant."""

class TestIntegration:
    """Integration and cross-cutting invariant tests."""

    def test_multiple_registries_independent(self, dim):
        """Multiple independent registries can coexist without interference."""
        reg1 = EmbeddingStrategyRegistry(dimensions=dim)
        reg2 = EmbeddingStrategyRegistry(dimensions=256)

        strat1 = ValidAsyncStrategy(dim=dim)
        strat2 = ValidAsyncStrategy(dim=256)

        reg1.register("semantic", strat1)
        reg2.register("temporal", strat2)

        assert reg1.has_strategy("semantic")
        assert not reg1.has_strategy("temporal")
        assert reg2.has_strategy("temporal")
        assert not reg2.has_strategy("semantic")
        assert reg1.dimensions == dim
        assert reg2.dimensions == 256

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_full_flow_register_embed_populate(self, make_signal, dim):
        """Full flow: init registry, register strategies, populate signal, verify."""
        registry = EmbeddingStrategyRegistry(dimensions=dim)
        registry.register("semantic", DeterministicStrategy(dim=dim, seed=1))
        registry.register("temporal", DeterministicStrategy(dim=dim, seed=2))

        signal = make_signal(
            id="integration-1",
            content="Full integration test content",
            author="integrator",
        )

        populated = await registry.populate_signal_embeddings(signal)

        # Verify all strategy keys present
        assert "semantic" in populated.embeddings
        assert "temporal" in populated.embeddings

        # Verify embedding lengths
        for key, emb in populated.embeddings.items():
            assert isinstance(emb, list), f"Embedding '{key}' should be list"
            assert len(emb) == dim, \
                f"Embedding '{key}' length {len(emb)} != {dim}"
            for val in emb:
                assert isinstance(val, float)

        # Verify original unchanged
        assert signal.embeddings == {} or len(signal.embeddings) == 0

        # Verify non-embedding fields preserved
        assert populated.id == "integration-1"
        assert populated.content == "Full integration test content"
        assert populated.author == "integrator"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_embed_all_concurrent_execution(self, registry, signal, dim):
        """embed_all executes strategies concurrently (not sequentially)."""
        call_times = []

        class TimedStrategy:
            def __init__(self, delay: float, seed: int):
                self._delay = delay
                self._seed = seed
                self._dim = dim

            async def embed(self, signal: Any) -> np.ndarray:
                import time
                start = time.monotonic()
                await asyncio.sleep(self._delay)
                end = time.monotonic()
                call_times.append((start, end))
                rng = np.random.RandomState(self._seed)
                vec = rng.randn(self._dim).astype(np.float32)
                norm = np.linalg.norm(vec)
                if norm > 0:
                    vec = vec / norm
                return vec

        registry.register("slow_a", TimedStrategy(delay=0.1, seed=1))
        registry.register("slow_b", TimedStrategy(delay=0.1, seed=2))

        import time
        overall_start = time.monotonic()
        result = await registry.embed_all(signal)
        overall_duration = time.monotonic() - overall_start

        assert len(result.embeddings) == 2
        # If concurrent, total time should be ~0.1s, not ~0.2s
        # Allow generous margin but ensure it's not strictly sequential
        assert overall_duration < 0.3, \
            f"embed_all took {overall_duration:.3f}s — strategies may not be concurrent"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_project_to_dim_integration_with_embed(self, make_signal):
        """Dimension projection integrates correctly with embed flow."""
        target_dim = 64

            """Returns a 256-dim vector that needs projection."""
            async def embed(self, signal: Any) -> np.ndarray:
                vec = np.ones(target_dim, dtype=np.float32)
                return vec / np.linalg.norm(vec)

        registry = EmbeddingStrategyRegistry(dimensions=target_dim)
        registry.register("oversized", OversizedStrategy())

        signal = make_signal(content="projection test")
        result = await registry.embed(signal, strategy="oversized")
        assert result.shape == (target_dim,)
